environment.description: Same Ktor microservice on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes a custom rule group with priority 1 that inspects URI path components using a regex pattern set matching path traversal indicators (decoded). Additionally, the EFS access point is configured with a POSIX user (uid=1000, gid=1000) and root directory creation permissions set to 0755 with owner enforcement. The container runs as non-root (uid=1000). The EFS file system policy denies the elasticfilesystem:ClientMount action unless aws:PrincipalTag/Environment equals 'production' AND the access point ARN matches. The mount target security group restricts NFS traffic (port 2049) to only the Fargate task ENI security group. A custom WAFv2 rule with field-to-match set to UriPath applies a regex_match on '(?i)(\.\.|%2e%2e|%252e|\x2e\x2e)' with BLOCK action and CloudWatch metric 'PathTraversalBlocked'. The ALB access logs are shipped to S3 with a lifecycle policy.

config.storage: EFS with access point enforcing POSIX uid=1000/gid=1000, root_directory=/uploads with permissions 0755
config.efs_file_system_policy: Deny ClientMount unless PrincipalTag/Environment=production AND via specific access point
config.mount_security_group: ingress port 2049 restricted to Fargate task SG only
config.network: private subnet, NAT gateway egress only
